title: Schema drift: when a source adds a column
objectives: Notice when a source's columns change
Combine batches by column name, not position
Give older rows a stated default for a new column

exercises.prompt: February's file added a currency column. Combine both months: order_id, amount and currency, with 'USD' for January's rows (it was the only currency then), in order_id order.
hints: The starter stacks the files by position and fails: the two months don't have the same number of columns.
Name the columns in each SELECT, and give January a currency of its own: 'USD' AS currency.
